ai_overview_text: The HubSpot CRM is the best overall choice for startups because it starts completely free and scales smoothly as your company grows.Choosing the right customer relationship management (CRM) tool depends on your team's specific goals and budget. Here are the top options for early-stage companies:Pipedrive: Best for sales-heavy teams. It uses a visual pipeline to help salespeople track daily tasks and close deals fast. Plans start around $34 per user monthly.Zoho CRM: Best for budget-conscious depth. It offers deep customization and built-in AI tools at a low price point. Plans are roughly $14 per user monthly.monday.com: Best for flexible workspaces. It blends project tracking and sales pipelines into a colorful, easy board.
